verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document any way to set up scheduled, triggered, or background-running automations. The autonomous-looking items are adjacent rather than this capability: /autoplan runs review skills in sequence with auto-decisions and /qa iteratively fixes bugs, but both are invoked in-session. The headless Chromium daemon is browser infrastructure, GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE is a self-update switch, and OpenClaw's ability to spawn sessions belongs to the host platform.
